title: Solution Architect, SAE
description:
NVIDIA’s Platform has already made a major impact to the field and is broadly used across leading Industry’s, including the world’s largest Internet companies. Our success has been based on laser\-focused industry vertical business development, building a strong developer ecosystem and scaling out the business using a partner channel and creative marketing. We need passionate, hard\-working and creative people to help us pursue more of these rare opportunities.
   

  

 We are now looking for a Solution Architect to focus on End to End Infrastructure, Starting from Data Centre’s, Solution Designs, Deep Learning, Machine Learning, and Accelerated Analytics, solutions to work with our teams in India, Bangalore. If this role sounds exciting, we should talk. Today, NVIDIA is acknowledged as the world leader in AI Accelerated computing. As a Solution Architect working at NVIDIA, you will work closely with multiple Customers across the country \- establishing relationships, solving problems and helping them build successful NVIDIA solutions.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Assist field business development in guiding the customer through the sales process for NVIDIA Products, owning the technical relationship and assisting customers in building innovative solutions based on NVIDIA Platforms
* Be an industry thought leader on integrating NVIDIA technology into multiple architectures to support AI at scale.
* An SME for large scale Software and Hardware Solution Design across AI \& Cloud Solutions.


**What We Need To See**
* B. Tech. or MS in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or Computer Science or equivalent experience.
* 8\+ years of work\-related experience in Solution Designing for Deep Learning, high\-performance computing and Cloud.
* Extensive Experience working with DevOps including but not limited to Docker/Containers, Kubernetes, and datacentre deployments.
* Excellent Pre\-sales experience on Network, Cloud, Big\-data/Analytics sizing, Large Scale Enterprise Solutions and RFP experience with the regional customers
* Software experience with modern, AI \& Cloud Stack, Deep Learning software architecture and frameworks is recommended.
* Deep understanding of dense datacentre design components including MEP, compute, storage and networking.
* Ability to multitask effectively in a dynamic environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong written and oral communications skills in English with the ability to effectively collaborate with management and engineering.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Experienced in Networking, Cloud, HPC, ML \& DL.
* Solution Designs \- Large scale Supercomputing build experience \-Datacentre to Compute to Network to Software.
* Experience in working with Partners, OEMs and Distribution teams.
* Outstanding customer facing skill\-set with excellent presentation skills

title: ET BMC - MarTech Solution Architect
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Discipline:** 
 Brand, Marketing and Communications (BMC)
   

  

**Role Type:** 
 ET BMC \- MarTech Solution Architect
   

  

**The opportunity**
 The BMC MarTech Solution Architect plays a pivotal role in defining and enabling the future of BMC's digital, data and marketing technology ecosystem. This role is part of the Enterprise Technology CBS Solutions Delivery Team and partners closely with Product Managers in Technology Enablement and cross\-functional business teams such as Clients \& Industries (C\&I), Talent, Alumni and Communications.
   

  

 The architect is responsible for translating business strategy into target\-state architecture, defining the practical transition states required to reach it, and helping leadership and Product Managers convert that direction into prioritized, executable delivery roadmaps. The role brings together business, application, data, integration and technology perspectives to guide investment decisions and enable a scalable, data\-driven and AI\-enabled future.
   

  

 The role will also shape the future architecture of BMC's AI\-enabled MarTech ecosystem, defining how enterprise platforms, data, AI agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) services and emerging technologies work together securely and at scale to deliver business value.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Own and maintain the BMC MarTech architecture strategy, vision and target\-state architecture.
* Develop future\-state business, capability, application, data, integration and technology architectures aligned to business priorities and enterprise standards.
* Assess the current landscape and define transition\-state architectures, capability increments and migration approaches required to reach the target state.
* Partner with Product Managers and business leaders to translate architecture into phased multi\-year delivery roadmaps, investment plans and measurable business outcomes.
* Identify cross\-product dependencies, sequencing requirements, constraints, technical debt and transformation risks, and ensure these are reflected in delivery planning.
* Produce capability maps, architecture blueprints, heat maps, maturity assessments, integration views and transformation roadmaps that support clear decision\-making.
* Translate strategic business needs into end\-to\-end solution options and recommendations, including benefits, costs, risks, compliance, technical debt and long\-term sustainability.
* Advise senior leadership on technology strategy, platform evolution, investment priorities, sourcing choices and the implications of architecture decisions.
* Define and maintain MarTech architectural principles, standards, reusable patterns and reference architectures.
* Define architectural patterns for AI agents, agent orchestration, MCP\-enabled integrations and emerging digital worker capabilities across the MarTech ecosystem.
* Assess emerging technologies, including agentic AI, MCP frameworks, orchestration platforms and autonomous workflow capabilities, and determine their applicability to BMC business outcomes.
* Define the governance, security, identity, observability and interoperability patterns required to support AI\-enabled products and services at enterprise scale.
* Act as the architectural connector across BMC, ET, C\&I, Talent, Alumni and Communications, ensuring alignment across products, programmes and business functions.
* Reduce duplication and complexity by promoting reuse of enterprise platforms, shared capabilities, common data and agreed standards.
* Collaborate with Data Architecture teams to define AI\-ready data models, taxonomies, metadata structures and information flows.
* Ensure MarTech platforms integrate effectively with enterprise data lakes, CDPs, analytics platforms, identity services and consent capabilities.
* Assess emerging technologies and evaluate platform and vendor options with Product Management teams.
* Support business cases, portfolio prioritisation, design assurance and enterprise governance forums.
* Promote API\-first, event\-driven, modular and composable architecture principles.
* Champion security, privacy, accessibility, performance, resilience, observability and global scalability throughout the product lifecycle.
* Communicate complex architectural concepts and trade\-offs in clear, business\-focused language for executive, product and delivery audiences.
* Serve as a trusted advisor on MarTech strategy, transformation, innovation and platform evolution.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Deep knowledge of MarTech ecosystems, including CRM, CDP, CMS, DAM, marketing automation, analytics, identity and consent.
* Strong architecture modelling capabilities across business, capability, data, application, integration and technology domains.
* Proven experience producing current\-state assessments, target\-state architectures, transition\-state designs and migration strategies.
* Experience developing multi\-year transformation roadmaps and working with Product Managers to convert architectural direction into sequenced delivery plans.
* Ability to translate executive objectives and business outcomes into actionable architecture, investment priorities and delivery roadmaps.
* Experience leading architecture across complex transformation programmes involving multiple platforms, products and business functions.
* Knowledge of emerging AI architecture patterns, including agentic systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP), orchestration frameworks, retrieval architectures and AI governance.
* Experience evaluating emerging technologies and translating innovation opportunities into pragmatic architecture and product roadmaps.
* Strong commercial and strategic thinking, with experience supporting business cases, option assessments, vendor evaluations and investment decisions.
* Experience designing integrations across multiple enterprise platforms and data ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data strategy, data governance, privacy, security and AI enablement.
* Excellent communication, leadership, facilitation and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders.
* Architecture certification such as TOGAF, ArchiMate or equivalent, with relevant cloud certification desirable.
* Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud, MS Dynamics, CDPs, DAM or comparable enterprise platforms.


**Typical architecture outputs**
* Current\-state and target\-state architecture views.
* Transition\-state architecture and migration approaches.
* Business capability maps, maturity assessments and heat maps.
* Multi\-year architecture and technology transformation roadmaps.
* Solution blueprints, integration architectures and data flow models.
* AI agent, orchestration and MCP\-enabled integration architecture patterns.
* Architecture principles, standards, reusable patterns and reference architectures.
* Solution option assessments, architecture decision records and investment recommendations.
* Dependency, risk, technical debt and sequencing views that support portfolio and product planning.


**Technologies and Tools**
* MarTech and AdTech platforms, including Adobe and demand\-side platforms.
* CDP, CMS, CRM, DAM, marketing automation and analytics platforms, including Adobe, MS Dynamics and Microsoft Azure ecosystems.
* AI and agentic platforms, orchestration frameworks, retrieval services and enterprise knowledge platforms.
* MCP\-enabled integration patterns and services.
* API\-led, ESB, event\-driven and composable integration approaches.
* Cloud platforms, including Azure, AWS and GCP.
* Architecture and modelling tools, including LeanIX, ArchiMate and Lucidchart.


**What We Offer**
 We offer the opportunity to shape the future of BMC’s enterprise technology landscape, with significant influence across ET, C\&I, Talent, Alumni, and Communications. You will collaborate with global teams, drive architectural standards, and help build an AI\-enabled future through strong partnership with Data Architecture.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You will develop the skills and capabilities needed to thrive in a rapidly evolving digital and AI environment.
* Success, as defined by you: We empower you with tools, flexibility, and support to make a meaningful impact.
* Transformative leadership: You’ll receive coaching, enablement, and opportunities to lead strategic technology decisions that impact the global organisation.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be valued for your perspective and empowered to help shape a culture of innovation and inclusion.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Staff Architect II, Software & Data Architecture
description:
**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**







 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on
 
  
 


**Glassdoor's Best Places to Work** 
  
 


 list and have earned the \#1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
 




  





  






**WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH**


  
 





 Y
 

 ou'll join Bain's NextGen Software Solutions (NGSS) team, where we build and support software products that help power the firm's work.
 





 As a Staff Architect II, you'll be the technical owner of a
 


**Coro** 


  product workstream within NGSS. The Coro team is focused on building and scaling Bain's proprietary data and product e
 

 cosystem. We develop and manage platforms such as BizMap and Helix, which power data\-driven insights and solutions across Bain's commercial and private equity practices.
 




  






**WHERE YOU'LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAM** 
  
 





 As a Staff Architect II, you'll play a hands\-on engineering leadership role \- writing code, setting technical standards, reviewing the team's work, and driving the architectural direction and delivery of your workstream.
 





 You'll partner closely with Product Managers to translate the product roadmap into actionable engineering plans, mentor engineers, remove technical blockers, and serve as the primary technical liaison between product leadership and Bain's broader platform teams. * Provide technical leadership, governance and architectural direction to internal and external development teams on the design, development, implementation, and deployment of highly usable and scalable software

**Team Leadership \& Development** 

* Lead, mentor, and grow multiple engineering teams across products, services, and projects
* Run technical standups, manage individual workloads, provide structured feedback, and grow junior engineers while maintaining delivery pace
* Support team in recruiting activities (resume screening, interviews, etc.)



**Stakeholder Alignment** 

* Ensure the workstream's builds stay compatible with and contribute back to the shared Bain platform
* Represent the workstream team in technical touchpoints with practice leadership and external engineering partners



**Innovation \& Emerging Technologies** 

* Drive innovation through out\-of\-the\-box thinking to solve critical business challenges and demands
* Participate in technical discovery, POCs, and innovation workstreams to validate new tools, technologies, and designs
* Investigate and keep up\-to\-date on emerging data, AI, and agentic technologies and trends; lead knowledge sharing
* Entrepreneurial spirit, willing to try new approaches
* Comfortable in a consulting\-adjacent product context, turning ambiguous requirements into well\-scoped engineering work



  





  





**ABOUT YOU**





**Education** 




* Bachelor's or Engineering degree or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience




**Technical** 




* Software and data architecture experience in a senior technology leadership role
* Track record in building and running scalable cloud\-based B2B software products
* Strong backend experience in Python (FastAPI or similar), with Node.js and C\# /  ASP.NET in the stack, plus TypeScript/React for full\-stack work
* Deep experience with cloud\-native Azure (Container Apps, Functions) and containerized deployments (Docker, Docker Compose)
* Working knowledge of LLM APIs and agent orchestration frameworks, enough to make sound design calls on agent structure, tool\-calling, and prompt management
* Working knowledge of data pipelines and stores (SQL schemas, ETL, data quality) across relational and analytical systems (Azure SQL, Postgres, Snowflake)

* Familiarity with AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) to speed up development

title: Platform Lead
description:
As the global leader in high\-speed connectivity, Ciena is committed to a people\-first approach. Our teams enjoy a culture focused on prioritizing a flexible work environment that empowers individual growth, well\-being, and belonging. We’re a technology company that leads with our humanity—driving our business priorities alongside meaningful social, community, and societal impact.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced ServiceNow Platform Lead with a minimum of 8 years of experience to take technical and architectural ownership of our ServiceNow platform.
   

  

 The ideal candidate must be an excellent developer, a strong solution architect, and a strategic thinker who can identify how ServiceNow can deliver measurable business value.
   

  

 The candidate must be highly self\-driven and capable of joining an existing ServiceNow environment, independently understanding its architecture, and taking ownership with minimal or no formal knowledge transfer.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Own the technical direction, architecture, stability, security, and overall health of the ServiceNow platform.
* Independently assess the existing platform, including configurations, customizations, applications, integrations, data models, security, and technical dependencies.
* Design scalable, secure, maintainable, and upgrade\-friendly ServiceNow solutions.

title: Solution Architect
description:
About Vorro
 



 Vorro is an enterprise data integration company and the creator of the BridgeGate Enterprise Integration Platform as a Service (EiPaaS). BridgeGate uses a patented any\-to\-any integration technology, with visual mapping and workflow orchestration, to connect applications, business processes and external trading partners without the cost of custom interface development.
 



 Vorro has been deployed in over 100 enterprise environments across healthcare, retail, insurance, logistics and specialty networks, with particular depth in healthcare, where BridgeGate helps payers, providers, EMR vendors, HIEs and pharmacies exchange clinical and financial data using standards such as HL7, CCD/CCDA and FHIR. Alongside the platform, Vorro offers fully managed integration services, taking ownership of data interfacing and partner coordination on customers’ behalf.
 



 Role Overview
 



 We are looking for a Solution Architect to own the technical design and solution roadmap for Vorro customer engagements built on BridgeGate. This is a customer\-facing role: you will translate multi\-system integration requirements into clear architectures, define phased implementation roadmaps, and govern delivery against them from discovery through production rollout.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



**Solution Architecture and Design** 



* Own end\-to\-end solution architecture for integration engagements on BridgeGate, covering integration patterns, data flow, interface design, security and scalability.
* Run discovery workshops to capture business processes, source and target systems, data formats and compliance needs, and convert these into documented technical requirements.
* Design any\-to\-any integration solutions across applications, EMRs, HIEs, payer systems, trading partners and internal enterprise systems, defining the data mapping and transformation logic involved.
* Produce and maintain solution design documents, interface specifications and data flow diagrams, and design for throughput, availability, error handling and monitoring.



**Solution Roadmapping** 



* Build robust, phased solution roadmaps for each engagement, covering current state, target state, milestones, dependencies and sequencing.
* Maintain and revise the roadmap through the engagement as scope or priorities shift, and run regular checkpoints with customer and internal leadership on progress.
* Define migration roadmaps for customers moving off legacy interface engines onto BridgeGate, and scalability roadmaps so delivered solutions can absorb new partners and volumes without re\-architecture.
* Feed capability gaps identified in customer roadmaps back to Product and Engineering.



**Pre\-Sales and Customer Engagement** 



* Support sales with technical discovery, solution positioning, architecture walkthroughs and proof of concept.
* Contribute solution design, estimates and delivery roadmap to RFPs, proposals and statements of work.
* Act as trusted technical advisor to customer stakeholders, from integration analysts to CIOs.



**Delivery Governance** 



* Govern implementation against the approved architecture and roadmap through design reviews and go\-live readiness checks.
* Provide technical guidance to integration developers and support engineers through build, testing and deployment.
* Lead resolution of escalated technical issues in production\-critical integrations, and ensure solutions meet security, compliance and audit requirements.



 Required Qualifications and Skills
 


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering or a related field.
* 7 to 10 years of total IT experience, including at least 2 years in a Solution Architect, Technical Architect or Integration Architect capacity.
* Hands\-on background with integration platforms, interface engines, ESB or iPaaS technologies, and API design.
* Working knowledge of data formats and protocols: XML, JSON, EDI, flat file, REST, SOAP, SFTP and messaging systems.
* Demonstrated experience building and owning solution roadmaps, including phasing, milestones and stakeholder alignment.
* Strong data mapping and transformation expertise across systems with no common standard.
* Good understanding of cloud/hybrid deployment, and experience designing for security and compliance in regulated environments.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to work directly with customers in a pre\-sales or delivery capacity.



 Preferred Qualifications
 


* Experience with healthcare interoperability standards: HL7 v2, CCD/CCDA, FHIR, X12 EDI.
* Experience integrating EMR, EHR, HIE, pharmacy or payer systems, and familiarity with HIPAA requirements.
* Cloud or architecture certifications such as AWS, Azure or TOGAF.
* Experience working with US\-based customers and partial overlap with US time zones.



 What We Offer
 


* Ownership of the architecture and roadmap for enterprise integration programmes with measurable business impact.
* Exposure to a patented integration platform and complex, standards\-driven interoperability problems.
* Direct engagement with senior customer stakeholders and a path to principal or practice leadership roles.

**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony's Risk Team provides independent oversight of Synchrony’s risk\-taking activities to ensure safety and soundness, meet regulatory and legal requirements, and manage risks to the risk\-appetite of the Board. Risk is responsible for independently assessing, quantifying, and overseeing risks \& providing effective challenge . Risk serves as Synchrony’s Second Line of Defense.
   

  

 Overall, Risk Team oversees and manages the Risk Program to support the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues and challenges. Results are consistent with the respective strategic uses and complying with related overall risk, risk testing policies, standards, procedures as well as regulations. Our Risk organization consists of 4 pillars: Compliance, Credit \& Financial Risk, Enterprise Risk and Operational Risk. Each of the pillars play a vital role in managing Risk and supports the business in anticipating and addressing risks, issues, and challenges.
   

  

**Role Summary/ Purpose**
 The
 **eGRC Solution Architect** 
 is an individual contributor who partners with one or more Agile teams within the Risk Infrastructure delivery team to support Risk \& Compliance stakeholder s . This role translates enterprise GRC objectives into technology solutions that
 **automate, standardize, and integrate** 
 governance, risk management, and regulatory compliance processes. The architect designs end\-to\-end solutions, decomposes complex objectives into actionable deliverables, evaluates and aligns technical standards and tools, and provides technical leadership across the full delivery lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and deliver GRC solutions:  Serve as the GRC technical architecture lead supporting multiple concurrent initiatives, designing end\-to\-end solutions that span GRC functions, provide design guidance, conduct architecture reviews, and resolving complex technical decisions.
* Translate requirements into technical solutions: Work with stakeholders, including Risk and Compliance leaders , to understand GRC requirements and translate them into actionable, technology\-based solutions .
* Lead technical implementations :  Guide and support development teams and related technical resources through the configuration and deployment of GRC software platforms.
* Provide technical and architectural guidance: Serve as the subject matter expert for GRC frameworks, processes (e.g., RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments), enabling technologies, and industry best practices. Partner with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions; lead architecture/design reviews; mentor teammates ; and maintain architecture diagrams and technical documentation.
* Manage project oversight: Oversee the technical vision of GRC projects, ensuring delivery excellence, security, and sustainability while also managing timelines, scope, and resources alongside project managers.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor's Degree and 10 \+years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12\+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience
* Deep GRC domain knowledge: Strong understanding of GRC concepts and core processes (e.g., RCSA, Issue Management, Compliance Risk Assessments) and how they align to risk and control objectives .
* GRC platform expertise : 5\+ years of hands\-on advanced configuration/development experience with leading GRC platforms , including ServiceNow IRM, Archer , SAI360 .
* Solution architecture experience: 5\+ years designing and delivering end\-to\-end GRC solutions on ServiceNow, Archer, or SAI360, including target\-state architecture, standards, and non\-functional requirements.
* Problem\-solving and analytical skills: Proven ability to assess business needs, evaluate risk and control impacts, identify trade\-offs, and design scalable solutions that meet functional requirements.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Architectural and technical skills:  Proficiency in designing complex systems, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), and enterprise integration via APIs and data pipelines.
* Communication and stakeholder management: The ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including senior leadership.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's Degree and 10 \+years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience or in lieu of degree High School Diploma/GED 12\+ years of overall experience or equivalent leadership program experience


**Work Timings:** 
**2:30 PM to 11:30 PM IST**
 We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR.
   

  

 Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

title: Cloud Security Architect
description:
**Job Summary**
 Minfy Tech is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Cloud Security Architect to join our team. In this role, you will be a critical leader in helping our customers migrate their on\-premise environments to AWS while transforming and enhancing their security posture. Your primary responsibility will be to analyze our customers' existing IT landscapes, understand their security and network architectures, and design secure and scalable AWS solutions. You will be instrumental in helping customers modernize their security infrastructure, including migrating from legacy firewalls to advanced VM\-series firewalls and adopting SD\-WAN technologies.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Security Architecture Design:
* Assess customers' existing security and network architectures in on\-premise environments.
* Design secure, scalable, and cost\-effective AWS cloud solutions aligned with industry best practices and regulatory requirements.
* Develop detailed security architecture diagrams, documentation, and migration plans.
* Recommend and implement security enhancements and transformations, such as moving to VM\-series firewalls and SD\-WAN.
* Cloud Security Implementation:
* Configure and deploy AWS security services (e.g., IAM, Security Hub, GuardDuty, CloudTrail, VPCs, Security Groups, NACLs) to protect workloads in the cloud.
* Implement and manage security infrastructure, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and web application firewalls (WAFs).
* Automate security configuration and deployment using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like CloudFormation or Terraform.
* Security Transformation:
* Lead the transformation of customers' security posture from traditional models to modern, cloud\-centric approaches.
* Provide expertise in migrating from port\-based firewalls to advanced VM\-series firewalls and implementing SD\-WAN technologies.
* Design and implement network segmentation strategies to isolate workloads and minimize the attack surface.
* Risk Management and Compliance:

 As an ideal candidate, you will have

* Experience designing migrations of production workloads between relational databases and MongoDB
* Strong SaaS and product\-engineering knowledge, including multi\-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, backward compatibility, and managed\-cloud, Kubernetes\-based private\-cloud, or self\-managed on\-premises deployments
* The ability to influence engineers and stakeholders without formal authority through technically sound, practical designs; explain trade\-offs clearly; identify risks early; and balance delivery speed, quality, and long\-term maintainability
* Willingness to travel regularly to ISV partner locations


 As an ideal candidate, you may also have
   

  

* Experience working inside an ISV or product company, including in a forward\-deployed, resident\-architect, embedded\-architect, or similar technical delivery role
* Familiarity with event\-driven architectures and technologies such as Kafka or Debezium
* Experience with regulated or data\-intensive industries and their security, compliance, and data\-governance requirements
* MongoDB certification, MongoDB Atlas experience, or experience with MongoDB’s broader product portfolio


 What you will learn
   

  

* Deepen your expertise across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, application development, data modeling, search, vector workloads, and the broader MongoDB ecosystem
* Develop advanced experience in multi\-database application architecture, database coexistence, migrations, cloud\-native deployment, and the operational considerations of partner products
* Work across ISV products, technology stacks, industries, and deployment environments while building reusable architecture patterns and developing your technical influence and leadership

 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. title: Senior Software Development Engineer

As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
   

  

 Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
   

  

**Introduction to team**
 The Lodging connectivity Organization at Expedia Group is seeking an experienced backend developer and a seasoned technologist with a passion for building robust, scalable, and high\-performance applications that help millions of people plan their travels and create lifelong memories. Join us as we revolutionize the travel industry!
   

  

 The organization owns a core lever of Expedia Group's growth: expanding global lodging supply and making it a source of competitive advantage. We build and operate the platform that sources, normalizes, and serves third\-party lodging inventory — powering the shopping, booking, servicing, and claims journeys that travelers rely on every day. Through resilient API integrations and AI agentic workflows, we bring diverse partner content onto a single platform and make it competitive, accurate, and bookable at scale.
   

  

 We are part of the partner connectivity platform that serves as the backbone of Expedia's business, powering an efficient two\-way marketplace that bridges supply and demand. Our platform sources properties and handles more than 3M transactions per minute. Built with modern technologies like Java, Kotlin, Spring, GraphQL, Kafka, DynamoDB, ML, Elasticsearch, and Redis on AWS, our ecosystem supports millions of travelers in finding the best travel products tailored to their needs.
   

  

 If you're passionate about creating transformative solutions, tackling large\-scale engineering challenges, and shaping the future of lodging supply, we'd love to have you on our team. Join us, and let's redefine the way the world travels together!
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Design, build, and evolve scalable, reliable services and software components, including system design, low\-level design, API design, and data modeling to support customer\-facing and platform experiences.
* Lead the technical design across domains and delivery of complex, multi\-quarter initiatives across the 3PI supply system that support shopping, booking, servicing, and claims journeys.
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of complex features or services, from technical design through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement in production.
* Break down large, ambiguous business problems into clear technical solutions that can be reused across multiple domains and services, driving streamlined execution by the team.
* Write, review, and maintain high\-quality, well\-tested code while driving best practices in code quality, security, observability, resilience, and performance.
* Improve technical quality and operational excellence by reducing incidents, enhancing observability, and optimizing performance, reliability, and cost.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML\-enabled solutions that improve traveler and business outcomes, applying AI\-driven systems, tools, and workflows to production\-grade software.
* Mentor and guide other engineers, sharing best practices in software engineering, testing, and architecture, and raising the overall engineering bar for the team.
* Partner with product, analytics, design, and engineering teams to apply data\-driven decision making, define success metrics, and improve system health and user outcomes over time.
* Contribute to architectural direction by participating in design reviews, proposing improvements, leading communities of practice, and helping shape long\-term technical strategy.
* Technologies we use: Java, Kotlin, Spring, GraphQL, Docker, Kafka, DynamoDB, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, Redis, Datadog, Splunk, and AWS cloud.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
* 10\+ years of professional, post\-college backend software development experience in an object\-oriented language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, or similar).
* Proven experience owning end\-to\-end delivery for services or components — design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support — within a multi\-service or multi\-domain environment.
* Deep understanding of software design principles, algorithms, and data structures, with a strong command of core engineering practices including object\-oriented design, testing, and version control.
* Hands\-on experience designing and consuming APIs, working with data models and storage systems, and applying system design principles to build reliable, maintainable systems.
* Hands\-on expertise with AI/ML frameworks and tools, and experience applying AI/ML concepts to real\-world products.
* Experience building on cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) with sound architectural patterns and scalable, cost\-efficient, production\-quality systems.
* Strong communication skills and a highly effective collaborator — able to articulate ideas to teammates, peers, and leaders, support them with data, and incorporate others' feedback to find common ground.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience designing and evolving service and application architectures for high\-traffic, distributed systems, including clear API contracts, data models, and low\-level designs.
* Demonstrated track record driving technical direction for services or domains, making data\-informed tradeoffs across scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.
* Experience with partner or third\-party integrations, supply/inventory systems, or high\-volume marketplace platforms.
* Strong focus on operational excellence, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, and continuous improvement of production systems and developer workflows.
* Experience leading cross\-team technical initiatives or migrations, influencing engineering best practices across a domain, and guiding teams on effective and responsible use of AI\-assisted development and testing tools.
* A self\-starter who embraces change and is always open to replacing what you built yesterday with something better today.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**About Us:** 




 We are a profitable health\-tech brand focusing on men's sexual wellness, scaling our revenue target from 5 cr to 40 cr this year. We have cracked Product\-Market Fit and are now rebuilding our core engine to handle an 8x traffic multiplier. Because of our niche, user data is highly sensitive.
 



  





**\[Expected Compensation Range: ₹35,00,000 – ₹55,00,000 per annum]** 




  





**The Role:** 




 The Permanent Player\-Coach We do not want an Engineering Manager who only manages Jira boards, nor do we want a lone\-wolf architect. This is a hands\-on Engineering Manager role. We expect a 60/40 split: you will spend the majority of your time writing the hardest architectural code and the remaining managing the humans writing the rest.
 



  





**Experience Range:** 




 8 to 12 years of backend development, with proven architectural responsibilities, system design and team management experience.
 



  





**The 6\-Month Trajectory:** 




 ● 
 **Months 1\-2 (Heavy Architecture):** 
 Your focus will be architecting the AWS\-to\-Zoho pipelines and queues, getting your hands dirty in the codebase, and earning the technical respect of the current team.
 



 ●
 **Months 3\-6\+ (The Steady State):** 
 You will take full ownership of the tech org and begin exploring the manager side of the role.
 



 You will be building critical features and running the Weekly Triage, conducting 1\-on\-1s, and partnering with the existing Tech Lead to optimize sprint delivery.
 



 You’ll begin representing the engineering function at the org level and with various internal/external stakeholders.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 ● Architect the Core (The "Player"): Design and build the resilient integration layer between our systems and the Zoho ecosystem.
 



 ● Lead the Team (The "Coach"): Partner with our existing Technical Lead (who will act as your elite Delivery Lead). Run the Weekly Triage, enforce strict Kanban flow, and protect the team from scope creep.
 



 ● Own System Security: Ensure secure API design, implementing data encryption, payload masking, and strict access controls to prevent data breaches of highly sensitive patient histories.
 



 ● Manage Technical Debt: Establish proper coding standards and automated testing thresholds without bringing feature velocity to a halt.
 



 ● Mentorship: Upskill a team of 5\-6 junior developers with the empathy and patience to turn them into enterprise\-grade engineers.
 



 ● Pair With The Product Management Function: Partner with the product management function to streamline the roadmap.
 



 ● Stakeholder Management: Be the face of the engineering organization for internal/external stakeholders.
 



  





**Requirements:** 




 ● 8 to 12 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record of managing at least one small team through a rapid scaling phase (the "1 to 10" journey).
 



 ● Senior\-level proficiency in backend architecture (Node.js) and relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL). Frontend experience, while not mandatory, will be a BIG plus.\*
 



 ● Deep, practical, hands\-on experience designing and managing message queues and asynchronous background jobs.
 



 ● Experience integrating complex third\-party enterprise suites (specifically CRMs) and handling massive traffic spikes.
 



 ● High empathy and low ego; you must know how to partner with an existing, hard\-working startup team rather than dictating changes on day one.
 



 ● Working knowledge of DevOps workflows on any of the public clouds (AWS\*, GCP, Azure)

title: Solutions Architect - India
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
   

  

****About The Role****
 We’re hiring Solution Architects to help the world’s best engineering organizations figure out what AI\-native software development actually looks like in production.
   

  

 This is a deeply technical, post\-sale role embedded inside SpaceXAI’s most strategic enterprise accounts. You’ll work directly with engineering teams to roll out high\-impact workflows, accelerate adoption, and help organizations fundamentally rethink how software gets built with AI.
   

  

 Solution Architects sit at the center of long\-term customer transformation. You’ll help customers move from initial excitement to deeply integrating engineering workflows that teams rely on every day. That means understanding how modern software organizations operate, identifying where Cursor can create the most leverage, and helping customers scale adoption across teams, platforms, and workflows over time.
   

  

 This role is highly hands\-on. You’ll configure environments, design workflows, run enablement sessions, and solve technical problems directly with developers and platform teams inside complex enterprise environments. You’ll also help engineering leaders think through rollout strategy, workflow evolution, and the long\-term architecture for AI\-native development.
   

  

 The best Solution Architects combine deep technical credibility with strong product instincts, high ownership, and the ability to influence how large engineering organizations evolve. Solution Architects are also equally comfortable debugging CI workflows, leading architecture reviews, and helping executives understand where AI changes the economics of software development.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
**Help Engineering Teams Adopt AI\-Native Development**
* Roll out Cursor across strategic engineering organizations
* Configure environments, design workflows, and run hands\-on enablement sessions
* Help developers integrate Cursor into real production workflows, not isolated demos
* Drive fast time\-to\-value and durable adoption across teams
* Identify workflow friction and solve problems quickly


**Expand Cursor Across the Organization**
* Identify where Cursor should expand next inside the customer environment
* Help engineering organizations evolve from isolated usage to company\-wide adoption
* Design rollout strategies for new workflows, teams, and platform groups
* Partner with customers to operationalize AI\-assisted development at scale
* Work closely with Account Executives during major expansion moments


**Become a Trusted Technical Partner**
* Build deep relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering leadership, and executive stakeholders
* Lead architecture reviews, technical working sessions, and strategic planning discussions
* Advise customers on developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and AI adoption strategy
* Coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to unblock customer progress
* Help organizations navigate workflow and operational change as AI\-native development evolves


**Drive Real Customer Outcomes**
* Help customers translate adoption into measurable engineering impact
* Connect Cursor usage to outcomes like faster iteration cycles, improved developer productivity, workflow efficiency, and engineering quality
* Help customers communicate the value of Cursor internally and build momentum for broader adoption
* Turn successful deployments into repeatable workflow patterns across the organization


**Help Make Cursor Indispensable**
* Deepen workflow adoption and long\-term product stickiness
* Monitor competitive risk and help customers standardize on Cursor over time
* Support recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction
* Help customers build workflows they can’t imagine operating without


**Shape the Future of the Product**
* Bring structured feedback from strategic customers into Product and Engineering
* Identify emerging workflow patterns, friction points, and enterprise requirements
* Help shape new capabilities through lighthouse customers and design partnerships
* Turn successful customer workflows into reusable playbooks and reference patterns


**You may be a fit if**
* You have a strong technical background in software engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, or developer tooling
* You have experience in customer\-facing technical roles such as Solution Architect, Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Architect, or similar
* You have the ability to work hands\-on with engineering teams while also operating strategically with technical leadership
* You have a strong understanding of developer workflows, SDLC tooling, integrations, CI/CD systems, governance, and enterprise engineering environments
* You have excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly across both technical and executive audiences
* You have strong instincts around workflow design, adoption strategy, and driving workflow change across engineering teams
* You have high ownership, strong execution skills, and comfort operating in fast\-moving environments with ambiguity
* You have a passion for developer tooling and strong conviction around how AI will reshape software engineering
* You are willing to travel to customers needed

title: Platform Engineer - OpenStack
description:
**Company Description** 
 Cloudstrats is an Indian exponential technology product company that builds Artificial Intelligence platforms powered by analytics and automation. Its solutions use computer vision, speech, and text technologies to address complex real\-world challenges for government and enterprise customers. The company’s platforms apply Deep Learning, NLP, and ML to support sustainable development goals across sectors such as citizen services, public safety, education, health, and transport. Cloudstrats delivers marquee projects including command control centers, e\-governance solutions, grievance redressal platforms, data hubs, fraud detection, and health systems. The organization is driven by the vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat and large\-scale digital transformation in India and beyond.
 



  





***Immediate Joiners preferred.***




  





**About the Role.** 




 We're looking for a hands\-on private\-cloud engineer who can take an OpenStack\-based platform from bare metal to a working, accepted, and supportable production environment — and then own it through its operational lifecycle.
 



 This is a greenfield deployment covering compute, software\-defined storage, GPU enablement, Kubernetes, and an AI/ML platform. You'll lead or contribute to technical delivery, automation, capacity growth, operational improvement, resilience testing, documentation, and training of the internal cloud team.
 



 This is not a role for someone who has only consumed OpenStack through a dashboard. We need someone who has deployed it, broken it, recovered it, automated it, and documented it — using Kolla Ansible as the deployment tooling.
 



 The role combines architecture input with hands\-on engineering. You won't be expected to single\-handedly deliver every specialist subsystem without support, but you must understand the full platform and be able to troubleshoot across its major layers.
 



  





**What You will do.** 




 Deployment \& Architecture
 


* Design and deploy a multi\-node OpenStack private cloud using Kolla Ansible
* Configure a highly available control plane and define service placement, failure domains, and network segmentation (management, API, provider, tenant, external)
* Deploy and configure core services: Keystone, Nova, Placement, Glance, Neutron, Cinder, Horizon
* Maintain version\-controlled inventory, configuration, and secrets\-management procedures
* Produce architecture documents, capacity plans, and implementation runbooks



 Storage
 


* Design and deploy a distributed software\-defined storage platform (Ceph preferred) as the shared substrate
* Integrate block/image storage with Glance, Cinder, and Nova; stand up an S3\-compatible object endpoint
* Define replication/erasure\-coding policies, failure domains, and capacity thresholds
* Validate failure, degraded\-mode, and recovery behaviour



 Networking \& Security
 


* Design and configure management, API, provider, tenant, storage, and tunnel networks
* Implement VLANs, overlays, routing, firewalling, and security groups per the organisation's addressing standards
* Apply security\-hardening baselines and maintain compliance evidence



 Compute \& Workloads
 


* Build and maintain golden images and flavour catalogues (CPU, memory, NUMA, huge pages, GPU profiles)
* Configure host aggregates, availability zones, and placement/scheduling policies
* Restore and re\-platform existing Windows and Linux workloads into the new environment



 GPU Enablement
 


* Enable GPU access end\-to\-end: firmware, BIOS, IOMMU, kernel parameters, drivers, device binding
* Configure PCI passthrough or vGPU as required; configure Nova PCI aliases, traits, and scheduler filters
* Expose GPU resources to Kubernetes worker nodes via appropriate device plugins



 Kubernetes \& AI/ML Platform
 


* Deploy and operate a highly available Kubernetes cluster on the private cloud
* Configure CNI, ingress, RBAC, CSI\-backed persistent storage, and GPU\-schedulable nodes
* Deploy an approved AI/ML workspace platform (notebooks, training jobs, model serving) with per\-project isolation and quotas



 Identity \& Enterprise Integration
 


* Integrate with the organisation's enterprise directory; configure SSO/federation across OpenStack, Kubernetes, and the AI workspace
* Implement role mapping, least\-privilege access, and credential\-rotation procedures



 Monitoring, Logging \& Audit
 


* Implement monitoring/alerting across hosts, OpenStack services, storage, VMs, Kubernetes, and GPU utilisation
* Configure centralised logging, audit collection, and alert escalation



 Resilience, Backup \& Recovery
 


* Define and execute resilience tests (compute/controller/storage/network/Kubernetes/GPU/identity failure scenarios)
* Validate backup/restore against agreed RTO/RPO targets
* Produce test plans, execution evidence, and resilience reports



 Restricted\-Network Delivery
 


* Build and maintain internal package repositories and private container registries
* Prepare an offline bill of materials (packages, images, charts, drivers, firmware, licenses)
* Establish controlled import, scanning, signing, and promotion procedures
* Ensure deployment, patching, and recovery can operate without dependency on public internet access



 Lifecycle Ownership
 *(post go\-live)* 



* Own technical evolution: capacity expansion, tuning, upgrades, automation
* Act as escalation point for platform issues; lead root\-cause analysis
* Maintain architecture documents, SOPs, and runbooks
* Train the internal cloud engineering team to independent competency



  





**Experience we Need.** 




  





 Core
 


* 6\+ years infrastructure/platform\-engineering experience; 3\+ years hands\-on OpenStack
* Demonstrable delivery of at least one production OpenStack environment from install through acceptance
* Evidence of personal technical contribution, not just project oversight



  





 OpenStack \& Kolla Ansible
 


* Strong working knowledge of Keystone, Nova, Placement, Glance, Neutron, Cinder, Horizon
* Hands\-on Kolla Ansible: inventory, globals config, secrets handling, bootstrap, prechecks, deployment, validation, upgrades
* Ability to troubleshoot containerised OpenStack services and deployment failures



  





 Storage
 


* Hands\-on experience with a distributed SDS platform (Ceph preferred)
* Experience integrating storage with Glance/Cinder/Nova and Kubernetes CSI



  





 Linux, Compute \& Networking
 


* Deep Linux systems engineering (kernel, drivers, systemd, networking, storage stacks)
* Strong KVM/QEMU understanding
* VLANs, overlays, routing, firewalling, DNS, NTP, load balancing



  





 Kubernetes \& AI Platforms
 


* Production Kubernetes deployment and operation experience
* GPU scheduling via vendor device plugins
* AI/ML platform deployment (notebooks, training, model serving) strongly preferred



  





 GPU Virtualisation
 


* PCI/IOMMU passthrough, device binding, driver installation and validation in VMs/containers



  





 Identity, Observability \& Automation
 


* Enterprise directory integration, SSO/RBAC, certificate and secrets management
* Strong Python/shell scripting and Ansible or equivalent IaC experience



  





 Restricted\-Network Environments
 


* Demonstrable experience delivering in air\-gapped or restricted\-network environments
* Comfortable with formal change control, security review, and audit evidence



  





**Desirable.** 



* Ceph RBD, CephFS, RADOS Gateway
* Octavia, Barbican, Ironic, Heat, Swift, Manila
* Kubeflow, JupyterHub, MLflow, Ray, KServe, vLLM, or comparable AI/ML platforms
* NVIDIA GPU operators or equivalent vendor tooling
* Multi\-site disaster recovery experience
* CKA / CKS / Linux / OpenStack certifications (supplementary to delivery evidence, not a substitute



  





**You will own.** 




 High\-level and low\-level architecture · Capacity\-sizing workbook · Kolla Ansible configuration · IP/VLAN/DNS/firewall matrix · Storage architecture and recovery procedures · GPU enablement report · Kubernetes and AI\-platform architecture · Restricted\-network BOM · Security baseline · Monitoring/logging catalogue · Backup/RTO/RPO design · Migration and cutover plan · Resilience test plan and evidence · As\-built documentation · Runbooks and SOPs · Training materials

title: Engineering Manager (Passkeys)
description:
**Engineering Manager, Passkeys**
 Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com.
   

  

**About the Role**
 As we establish our India Engineering Center of Excellence (COE), we are looking for an experienced
 **Engineering Manager** 
 who can lead and grow the Passkeys team. You will build the technology taking the world beyond passwords. Bitwarden is a credential provider across browser, desktop, and mobile, and the Passkeys team owns our implementation of WebAuthn and FIDO2 — creating and asserting credentials, integrating with each platform's credential provider APIs, and the emerging standards for moving credentials between providers so that users are never locked in.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Hire, develop, and retain a strong team of engineers
* Set and report on measurable goals and objectives for the team
* Facilitate team ceremonies including weekly syncs, backlog refinements, retrospectives, and sprint planning
* Monitor in\-flight work to identify blocked items, proactively drive resolution, and provide contextual updates outside of the team to the rest of the organization
* Own escalation and triage for production issues, community\-reported bugs, and enterprise customer escalations related to autofill behavior and desktop integrations
* Maintain a healthy, sprint\-ready backlog by prioritizing bugs and tech debt alongside feature work and ensuring all items are well\-defined with accurate descriptions, technical breakdowns, and designs prior to refinement
* Serve as the primary liaison between your engineering team and Design, Product, Architecture, and other engineering teams, fielding cross\-functional questions and maintaining alignment on priorities
* Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization to synthesize requests into prioritized, actionable work
* Continuously identify friction points in team processes and develop solutions to improve efficiency, quality, and developer experience
* Create an inclusive environment where teamwork and collaboration are valued
* Conduct regular 1:1s, develop individualized performance goals and growth plans, and identify stretch opportunities to support each engineer's career progression
* Perform annual or semi\-annual performance reviews when required


**What You'll Bring**
* 10\-12 years of demonstrated experience leading engineering teams or complex cross\-functional product engineering initiatives within a software engineering organization.
* Experience working in globally distributed Product Engineering, GCC, or Center of Excellence environments along with managing distributed or cross\-regional teams, including working across time zones.
* Proven ability to successfully lead delivery across engineering organizations and influence multiple stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of Agile software development, modern engineering practices, and product delivery lifecycles.
* Experience in Engineering Management, Technical Program Management, Engineering Delivery, Product Operations, Design Program Management, or similar leadership roles.
* Ability to communicate effectively with Engineering, Product, Design, and executive stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving, prioritization, and decision\-making skills with a continuous improvement mindset.
* A coaching\-oriented leadership style with demonstrated experience developing high\-performing teams.
* Strong technical background in CI/CD, automation \& release engineering \- sufficient to engage credibly in technical discussions and step in hands\-on when necessary.
* Excellent communication skills, with experience representing a team's work to leadership and stakeholders outside the team.
* Prior experience managing or working closely with BRE, SRE, DevOps, or Platform Engineering teams.
* Formal management training or certifications preferred.
* Experience with specific tools like Jira, Confluence, or similar project management platforms preferred with AI tooling for development and workflow support (Claude Code or similar).


**Success in This Role**
 You'll thrive in this position if you:
   

  

* Lead through influence, collaboration, and trust.
* Bring structure without introducing unnecessary processes.
* Balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution.
* Create clarity across complex, cross\-functional initiatives.
* Enjoy building teams, developing people, and enabling engineering excellence.
* Are energized by helping establish and scale a world\-class Engineering organization.


**Why Join Us**
 This is an opportunity to play a foundational role in shaping our India Engineering COE from the ground up.
   

  

 Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
   

  

 Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. You'll work alongside talented global teams, solve meaningful engineering challenges, influence how we scale our engineering organization \& contribute to products used by customers around the world.
   

  

 If you're passionate about building exceptional teams, enabling engineering excellence, and making a lasting impact within a fast\-growing engineering company, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

1. Own the engineering technical strategy and target\-state architecture across capability teams — Platform Engineering; Application Development; API \& Integration Services; Data \& Analytics Engineering; DevOps \& Site Reliability; and Quality Engineering

3. Act as the design authority for the programme, approving reference architectures, integration standards, engineering frameworks, and deployment patterns
4. Ensure reusable engineering components — APIs, SDKs, shared libraries, and templates — are produced to a common standard and published for cross\-ministry reuse



**Organisation \& Delivery** 



1. Mentor the engineering teams and the capability\-pod leadership, scaling the organisation in line with validated demand
2. Direct and coordinate the programme’s functional and technical resources as a single, integrated delivery organisation
3. Establish the operating model, engineering standards, and delivery culture for a fast\-growing national engineering capability
4. Establish DevOps/SRE practices — CI/CD, release management, monitoring for reliability and performance, and cost\-effective operations at production scale

 Strong command of modern software engineering — distributed systems, microservices, event\-driven architecture, and full\-stack application development

 CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, release management, monitoring, and reliable production operations at scale

 Microservices, event\-driven and API\-based design, service gateways, and multi\-cloud, on\-premise, and sovereign deployment patterns

 Automated testing frameworks, performance testing, and quality assurance practices across the software development lifecycle
5. **Cloud \& Infrastructure:** 
 Cloud architecture, identity and access management, scalability and reliability, and observability
6. **Cost Governance:** 
 Unit economics and cost management for compute, storage, and infrastructure, and forecasting against a programme budget
7. **Programme \& Delivery Management:** 
 Programme governance, portfolio prioritisation, budgeting, risk management, and multi\-workstream delivery
8. **Security, Data Protection \& Compliance:** 
 Access control, encryption, audit, the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, CERT\-In directions, and MeitY security standards

 Organisation design, hiring and capability development, performance management, and the management of delivery partners and vendors

6. Experience building and scaling high\-performing teams, including talent acquisition, capability development, and the management of delivery partners and vendors
7. Strong, current technical grounding in AI/ML and modern software architecture, with the standing to set technical direction and make model and architecture decisions
8. Prior Government/PSU experience is not essential; the ability to operate within public\-sector requirements for data protection, sovereign infrastructure, procurement, and audit is expected



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Programme Leadership \& Strategy** 



1. Set the vision, strategy, and delivery roadmap for AI/ML services across Digital India platforms and cross\-ministerial systems
2. Lead the end\-to\-end delivery of the programme’s portfolio of AI use cases across the capability teams, ensuring timely, high\-quality, and measurable outcomes
3. Establish and run programme governance — planning, prioritisation, risk management, and delivery reporting — and present progress and outcomes to NeGD leadership
4. Own the programme budget and cost governance, ensuring efficient use of compute, infrastructure, and manpower against the approved envelope



**Technical \& Architectural Direction** 



1. Own the AI/ML technical strategy and target\-state architecture across capability teams — Document Intelligence; Conversational \& Multilingual AI; Predictive Analytics; Visual AI \& Identity Verification; Agentic AI \& Workflow Automation; and Fraud \& Anomaly Detection
2. Set standards for model selection and build\-versus\-buy decisions, including the use of open\-source and sovereign models, fine\-tuning, retrieval\-augmented generation, and prompting
3. Act as the design authority for the programme, approving reference architectures, integration standards, evaluation frameworks, and inference and deployment patterns
4. Ensure reusable AI components — APIs, SDKs, model cards, and templates — are produced to a common standard and published for cross\-ministry reuse



**Organisation \& Delivery** 



1. Mentor the AI teams and the capability\-pod leadership, scaling the organisation in line with validated demand
2. Direct and coordinate the programme’s functional and technical resources as a single, integrated delivery organisation
3. Establish the operating model, engineering standards, and delivery culture for a fast\-growing national AI capability
4. Establish MLOps/LLMOps practices — model lifecycle management, evaluation, monitoring for drift and quality, and reliable, cost\-effective inference at production scale



**Empanelment, Procurement \& Partnerships** 



1. Govern the engagement of empanelled agencies at the discovered L1 rate card across resource, project, and turnkey modes — including agency selection, performance management, acceptance, and service levels
2. Manage relationships with technology, model, and infrastructure providers, including commercial terms, performance, and risk



**Governance, Security \& Responsible AI** 



1. Ensure all AI systems are delivered in line with the Responsible AI framework — risk assessment, human oversight, explainability, evaluation, and audit
2. Ensure security and data protection by design across the programme, in line with MeitY security standards, CERT\-In directions, and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
3. Ensure the appropriate use of sovereign infrastructure and coordinate with other MeitY agencies where relevant



**Technical Competencies** 



1. **AI/ML \& Generative AI:** 
 Strong command of the modern AI stack — large language models, transformer architectures, generative AI, natural language processing, agentic AI, retrieval\-augmented generation, computer vision, and classical and predictive machine learning
2. **MLOps \& LLMOps:** 
 Model lifecycle management, training and inference pipelines, model registries, evaluation harnesses, monitoring for drift and quality, and reliable production deployment
3. **Solution \& Platform Architecture:** 
 Microservices, event\-driven and API\-based design, model gateways, and multi\-cloud, on\-premise, and sovereign deployment patterns
4. **Generative AI Systems:** 
 Retrieval\-augmented generation pipeline design, vector databases and semantic search, prompt and evaluation strategies, and output safety and guardrails
5. **AI Evaluation \& Assurance:** 
 Evaluation frameworks, benchmarking, and red\-teaming for accuracy, fairness, robustness, and safety
6. **Cloud \& Inference Infrastructure:** 
 Cloud architecture, identity and access management, GPU/accelerator utilisation, scalability and reliability, and observability
7. **Cost Governance:** 
 Unit economics and cost management for compute, training, and inference, and forecasting against a programme budget
8. **Programme \& Delivery Management:** 
 Programme governance, portfolio prioritisation, budgeting, risk management, and multi\-workstream delivery
9. **Security, Data Protection \& Responsible AI:** 
 Access control, encryption, audit, the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023, CERT\-In directions, MeitY security standards, and the IndiaAI Responsible AI framework
10. **Organisational Leadership:** 
 Organisation design, hiring and capability development, performance management, and the management of delivery partners and vendors
11. **Communication \& Stakeholder Engagement:** 
 Executive communication of strategy, progress, and risk; leading technical reviews; and building alignment across technical and functional teams

title: Server Performance Architect - Hardware
description:
Job Requisition ID JR2016230
   

  

 Job Category Engineering
   

  

 Time Type Full time
   

  

 NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world!
   

  

 NVIDIA is seeking architects to drive architectural performance for its next\-generation AI server systems. This position demands a unique capability to bridge deep architectural knowledge, workload analysis, and hands\-on silicon investigations. Candidates should be adept at working directly with silicon, high\-level models, and simulators. Responsibilities include conducting performance investigations on both NVIDIA and competitive platforms, and developing targeted microbenchmarks to examine specific architectural aspects. The role does not heavily involve modeling tasks (functional or performance), though occasional focused assignments may arise.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Defining and driving server\-level performance targets across CPU, GPU, memory, interconnect, networking, and storage subsystems
* Conducting hands\-on workload characterisation and bottleneck analysis on NVIDIA and competitive server platforms using AI training, inference, and HPC benchmarks
* Leveraging profiling, tracing, and analysis tools to root\-cause performance issues and identify optimisation opportunities at the system level
* Performing trade\-off studies on system topology, thermal/power envelopes, and memory hierarchy to guide architectural decisions
* Collaborating with silicon, platform, firmware, and software teams to identify and close performance gaps from bring\-up through production
* Developing automation and tooling for performance regression tracking and reporting
* Representing the performance perspective in architecture reviews and cross\-functional design discussions
* Building and maintaining analytical performance models and simulation frameworks for next\-generation server platforms
* Publishing internal performance studies and best\-practice guides for partner and customer enablement


**What We Need To See**
* BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical/Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience
* 10\+ years of experience in server/system performance architecture or related disciplines
* Deep understanding of modern server architectures — CPU microarchitecture, PCIe/CXL, DDR/HBM memory subsystems, and coherency protocols
* Strong hands\-on experience with system\-level profiling and performance analysis tools on server platform(s)
* Solid knowledge of GPU\-accelerated compute, high\-performance networking, or high\-performance storage subsystems
* Proficiency in Python, C/C\+\+, or similar languages for scripting, data analysis, and tool development
* Comfortable and proficient using AI\-powered coding and productivity tools to accelerate analysis, automation, and documentation workflows
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to distil complex performance data into actionable architectural recommendations


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Experience with AI/ML training and inference workloads at data\-centre scale
* Familiarity with NVIDIA GPU architectures (Hopper, Blackwell, Rubin) and associated software stacks (CUDA, NCCL)
* Background in chip\-to\-chip interconnect performance analysis (C2C, UCIe)
* Exposure to power/thermal\-aware performance optimisation techniques
* Track record of contributions to industry conferences or published performance studies

description:
**Overview**
 WELCOME TO SITA
   

  

 At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork.
