 The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
   

  

**About The Role \& Team**
 The AI Tech Lead will establish and lead SITA for Aircraft's AI capability by building a high\-performing team, delivering practical AI solutions, and driving AI adoption across the organization.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on leadership role combining technical expertise, people leadership, and business engagement. The successful candidate will work closely with business and technology stakeholders to identify high\-value AI opportunities and convert them into scalable, production\-ready solutions that deliver measurable improvements in productivity, efficiency, and automation.
   

  

 As a key leader in the technology organization, you will drive the development of AI agents, copilots, automation solutions, and reusable AI capabilities while ensuring solutions meet enterprise standards for security, governance, reliability, and operational readiness.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 AI Delivery \& Adoption
   

  

* Partner with business teams to identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases with clear business value.
* Lead the design, development, and implementation of AI agents, copilots, and automation solutions.
* Drive successful adoption of AI solutions across teams and functions.
* Track and communicate AI usage, adoption, productivity gains, and business outcomes.
* Promote successful AI implementations and encourage reuse across the organization.


 Technical Leadership
   

  

* Remain hands\-on with AI technologies and contribute directly to solution architecture and development.
* Guide the team in building, testing, deploying, monitoring, and operating AI solutions.
* Support the resolution of complex technical and production issues.
* Establish engineering best practices for AI development, deployment, monitoring, and support.
* Create reusable AI frameworks, components, and accelerators that can be leveraged across multiple initiatives.


 Team Leadership
   

  

* Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing AI engineering team.
* Mentor, coach, and support the growth of team members.
* Define required skills, capabilities, and development plans for AI practitioners.
* Foster a culture of ownership, continuous learning, innovation, experimentation, and delivery.
* Encourage end\-to\-end accountability for AI solutions and business outcomes.


 Governance \& Operations
   

  

* Collaborate with Architecture, Security, Data, Platform, and Governance teams to enable responsible AI adoption.
* Ensure AI solutions comply with enterprise security, governance, and data management standards.
* Establish operational support and monitoring for production AI systems.
* Ensure solutions are secure, scalable, reliable, maintainable, and cost\-effective.


**Qualifications**
**ABOUT YOUR SKILLS**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* 12\+ years of experience in software engineering, technology, automation, or related technical fields.
* 3\-5 years of experience working with AI, Generative AI, AI automation, AI agents, copilots, LLMs, or Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions.
* Proven hands\-on technical leadership experience in leading and developing technical teams.
* Strong hands\-on expertise delivering AI solutions from proof of concept through to production deployment.
* Experience working with cloud platforms, APIs, DevOps practices, and enterprise production environments.
* Strong understanding of AI security, governance, data management, and responsible AI principles.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver measurable business outcomes through technology initiatives.
* Experience establishing or scaling an AI or Generative AI capability from the ground up.
* Experience implementing enterprise AI assistants, copilots, or intelligent agents.
* Experience integrating AI solutions into business processes and enterprise platforms.
* Background in automation, DevOps, IT operations, or service management.
* Experience within aviation or other operationally intensive industries.
* Focus on business value and measurable outcomes.
* Pragmatic decision\-making and problem\-solving.
* Continuous learning and innovation mindset.


**NICE TO HAVE**
* Spanish and/or French language skills are an advantage.


**What We Offer**
 We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.
   

  

 🏡
 **Flex Week:** 
 Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)
   

  

 ⏰
 **Flex Day:** 
 Make your workday suit your life and plans.
   

  

 🌎
 **Flex\-Location:** 
 Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.
   

  

 🌿
 **Employee Wellbeing:** 
 We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health \- a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.
   

  

 🚀
 **Professional Development:** 
 At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world\-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From
 **LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative,** 
 and

 \-available to all employees\-to specialized solutions like

 for people leadership,

 Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.

description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
   

  

 You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
   

  

 As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 In this role, your technical depth, business aptitude, and ability to steer technology discussions at all levels will enable you to shape the customer journey. Your thought leadership, ability to look beyond the technology, and more holistically at the value technology creates for our customers, is crucial to your success.
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect you’ll own the overall technical relationship between customers, AWS and partners, and make recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency. You will go beyond the technical solution architecture, work with partners, sellers and specialists to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology.
   

  

**About The Team**
 This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India, working with the customers to help drive AWS services adoption.
   

  

**About AWS**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
